atc_analysis.raw_markdown:
### 1. Standard Documents Required
* **OEM Authorization Certificate**

### 2. Clarified ATC Documents & Mandatory Uploads
* **Certificate**: MII Class 1/Class 2 Local Suppliers Certificate (self-authenticated), No Relation Certificate, Declaration regarding Local content in Ex-works price, Certificate regarding registration with DPIIT (Public Procurement No. 1, 2 & 3), Certificate regarding testing of imported items (MoP, GOI orders).
* **Additional Doc 1**: Copy of valid PAN, GST Registration Certificate, Status of the organization (Company Registration Certificate/Article of Association/Proprietorship/Partnership deed), Letter of Bid (Annexure-G), Details of Banker (Annexure-H), Notarised Affidavit (Annexure-I), Price Reasonability Certificate, Proprietary Article Certificate.
* **Other Upload Required in ATC**: Cancelled Cheque (for MICR verification), Specification document (duly signed and stamped).

### 3. Exemption Documents Required
* **Proof for Exemption (MSEs)**: Valid NSIC/MSME/UDYAM registration certificate (Explicit)
* **Proof for Exemption (Start-ups)**: DPIIT Startup Recognition Certificate (Inferred)

### 4. Physical Submissions (Offline)
* **Notarised Affidavit (Annexure-I)**: Must be executed on Non-Judicial Stamp Paper (minimum value of Rs. 10).
  * Deadline: At time of bid submission (uploaded as scanned copy).

### 5. Key Commercial Terms & Conditions to Follow
* **Price Basis**: Rates must be Firm, FOR-Destination (KTPS), and inclusive of all taxes, duties, freight, and P&F.
* **Payment Terms**: 100% payment within 10 days of CRAC and online bill submission via DVC Portal.
* **Guarantee/Warranty**: 18 months from delivery or 12 months from commissioning, whichever is earlier.
* **Security Deposit**: 3% of the bill amount will be retained as Security Deposit-cum-Performance Guarantee.
* **Liquidated Damages (LD)**: 0.5% of the value of delayed materials per week of delay, capped at 5% of total order value.
* **Option Clause**: Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease quantity by up to 25% at contracted rates.
* **Packing & Marking**: Packages must be marked in at least 2 places with Purchaser/Consignee name, PO No., Gross/Net weight, and dimensions using indelible paint.
* **Offer Validity**: Minimum 90 days from the date of opening of the enquiry.
* **Deviation Policy**: Any deviation from terms must be submitted via GeM portal *before* participation; participation implies unconditional acceptance of all terms.
